## `account`

- [`aitbc account get`](account-get.md) — Fetch on-chain information for a given account address, including balance and nonce.
- [`aitbc account list`](account-list.md) — List all known accounts from the blockchain RPC.

## `agent`

- [`aitbc agent capabilities`](agent-capabilities.md) — Show auto-detected system capabilities for a specified agent.
- [`aitbc agent config-export`](agent-config-export.md) — Export a named agent's configuration to a JSON file.

- [`aitbc agent config-validate`](agent-config-validate.md) — Validate the configuration of a named agent against the schema.
- [`aitbc agent create`](agent-create.md) — Create a new agent and register it in the local agent directory.
- [`aitbc agent discover agents`](agent-discover-agents.md) — Search remote agents by capability, type, and minimum health score.
- [`aitbc agent get-identity`](agent-get-identity.md) — Get an agent's on-chain identity record for the given ID.
- [`aitbc agent inbox`](agent-inbox.md) — View messages in a specified agent's inbox from the coordinator.
- [`aitbc agent list`](agent-list.md) — List all local agents configured in the agent directory.
- [`aitbc agent register`](agent-register.md) — Register a local agent with the coordinator by agent ID.
- [`aitbc agent register-identity`](agent-register-identity.md) — Register an agent's identity and address on the blockchain.
- [`aitbc agent status`](agent-status.md) — Get the current status and health of a specified agent.
- [`aitbc agent subscribe`](agent-subscribe.md) — Subscribe an agent to a message topic on the coordinator.
- [`aitbc agent verify-identity`](agent-verify-identity.md) — Verify an agent's identity using a verifier address on the blockchain.
- [`aitbc agent workflow create-workflow`](agent-workflow-create-workflow.md) — Create a new multi-step workflow from a steps definition file.
- [`aitbc agent workflow execute`](agent-workflow-execute.md) — Execute a previously created workflow with the given input file.
- [`aitbc agent workflow list-workflows`](agent-workflow-list-workflows.md) — List all workflows registered with the coordinator.
- [`aitbc agent workflow workflow-status`](agent-workflow-workflow-status.md) — Get the current execution status of a workflow by workflow ID.

## `agent-comm`

- [`aitbc agent-comm collaborate`](agent-comm-collaborate.md) — Create a multi-agent collaboration with a list of agent IDs.

## `agent-msg`

- [`aitbc agent-msg peers`](agent-msg-peers.md) — List the peers currently known to the Agent Coordinator.
